石.name: Stone
石.meaning: The <radical>stone</radical> radical: a rock that fell off a cliff. <kanji>Stone</kanji>.
石.reading: You throw the stone into a sack of rice, せき. On its own a stone is いし.

王.name: King
王.meaning: The <radical>king</radical> radical: <kanji>king</kanji>. Heaven, earth and man, joined by the one who rules them.
王.reading: The king cries "ow!", おう, every time he sits on his spiky throne. 王様 is a king.

草.name: Grass
草.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical> over something <radical>early</radical>. The first thing to grow in the <radical>early</radical> spring is <kanji>grass</kanji>.
草.reading: It grows through a crushed soda can, そう. On its own grass is くさ.

耳.name: Ear
耳.reading: A jeep, じ, drives right past your ear. On its own an ear is みみ.

合.name: Fit
合.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> with a lid on a <radical>mouth</radical>. The lid <kanji>fit</kanji>s exactly, joined to the <radical>ground</radical> line.
合.reading: Knock it on with a golf ball, ごう. 合う is to fit; 試合 a match (あい); 合格 passing (ごう).

市.name: City
市.meaning: A <radical>top hat</radical> above a <radical>towel</radical>. The hat seller and the towel seller set up the first market, and the <kanji>city</kanji> grew around it.
市.reading: Sheep, <reading>し</reading>, wander the city streets. <ja>市場</ja> is a market; <ja>市民</ja> citizens.

内.name: Inside
内.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> ducking into a <radical>helmet</radical>. They're safe <kanji>inside</kanji>.
内.reading: Inside there's a knife, ない. 案内 is guidance; うち on its own is inside.

回.name: Times
回.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> inside an <radical>enclosure</radical>, going round and round. Count the <kanji>times</kanji> it goes round.
回.reading: It's a kite, かい, flying in circles. 一回 is once; 回る to turn.

米.name: Rice
米.meaning: The <radical>rice</radical> radical: <kanji>rice</kanji>, uncooked. It also stands for America: <ja>米国</ja>.
米.reading: The rice is beige, べい, not white. On its own uncooked rice is こめ.

当.name: Hit
当.meaning: A <radical>triceratops</radical> with a <radical>broom</radical> for a body. It swings around and <kanji>hit</kanji>s everything.
当.reading: It hits a toad, とう. 本当 is truly; 当たる to hit.

首.name: Neck
首.meaning: The <radical>neck</radical> radical: <kanji>neck</kanji>. A head on a long neck, with two hairs on top.
首.reading: You hang a shoe, しゅ, round your neck. 首相 is prime minister; くび on its own is the neck.

数.name: Number
数.meaning: <radical>Rice</radical> and a <radical>woman</radical> with a <radical>whip</radical>. She cracks it every time you drop a grain while counting. <kanji>Number</kanji>s!
数.reading: She counts grains into her soup, すう. 数学 is maths; かず a number.

記.name: Record
記.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> it to <radical>oneself</radical>, then write it down. That's a <kanji>record</kanji>.
記.reading: Lock the record away with a key, き. 日記 is a diary; 記者 a reporter.

点.name: Point
点.meaning: A <radical>fortune</radical> teller over a <radical>fire</radical>. She reads the future from the <kanji>point</kanji>s where sparks land.
点.reading: She's reading a tennis racket, てん. 点数 is a score.

活.name: Lively
活.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> and a <radical>tongue</radical>. A dog laps up water with its tongue and runs around, <kanji>lively</kanji> again.
活.reading: It chases a pork cutlet, かつ. 生活 is daily life; 活動 activity.

原.name: Original
原.meaning: Under a <radical>cliff</radical>, something <radical>white</radical> and <radical>small</radical> bubbles out: a spring, the <kanji>original</kanji> source of the river.
原.reading: A genie, げん, lives in the spring. 原因 is cause; はら is a field.

交.name: Mix
交.meaning: A <radical>father</radical> in a <radical>top hat</radical>, legs crossed, going out to <kanji>mix</kanji> with the crowd.
交.reading: He's dancing with a koala, こう. 交通 is traffic; 交番 a police box.

組.name: Group
組.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> and <radical>moreover</radical> more thread, braided together. Braid strands and you make a <kanji>group</kanji>.
組.reading: They sew the group's names on a sewing needle, そ. On its own a group is くみ; 番組 is a TV programme (ぐみ).

引.name: Pull
引.meaning: A <radical>bow</radical> and a <radical>stick</radical>. Put the arrow on the bow and <kanji>pull</kanji>.
引.reading: You shoot it through the window of an inn, いん. 引く is to pull; 引っ越す to move house.

直.name: Fix
直.meaning: A <radical>cross</radical> over an <radical>eye</radical>. Line the eye up with the cross to check it's straight, then <kanji>fix</kanji> it.
直.reading: Fix the chalkboard, ちょく. 直す is to fix; 正直 honest (じき).

番.name: Number
番.meaning: A claw <radical>sort</radical>ing seeds over a <radical>rice paddy</radical>, planting them in rows. Each row gets a <kanji>number</kanji>.
番.reading: They're delivered by van, ばん. 一番 is number one; 番号 a number.

声.name: Voice
声.meaning: A samurai (<kanji>士</kanji>) leaning out of a doorway, shouting. He has a very loud <kanji>voice</kanji>.
声.reading: He's shouting orders to sail, せい. On its own a voice is こえ.

形.name: Shape
形.meaning: Something <radical>dry</radical> twice, then <radical>hair</radical>. Dry hair holds its <kanji>shape</kanji>.
形.reading: It's shaped like a cake, けい. 形 on its own is かたち; 人形 is a doll (ぎょう).

頭.name: Head
頭.meaning: A <radical>bean</radical> next to a <radical>head</radical>. It's a bean-shaped <kanji>head</kanji>.
頭.reading: A toad, とう, sits on top of it. On its own a head is あたま; 頭痛 is a headache (ず).

光.name: Light
光.meaning: A <radical>triceratops</radical> standing on the <radical>ground</radical> on long <radical>legs</radical>, with <kanji>light</kanji> beaming out of its horns.
光.reading: A koala, こう, reads by it. 光る is to shine; 観光 sightseeing.

科.name: Department
科.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> weighed with a <radical>dipper</radical>. The grain <kanji>department</kanji> sorts everything into sections.
科.reading: Each section gets its own car, か. 科学 is science; 教科書 a textbook.

太.name: Fat
太.meaning: <radical>Big</radical> with a <radical>drop</radical> underneath. Even bigger than big: <kanji>fat</kanji>.
太.reading: Too fat for his tie, たい. 太る is to get fat; 太陽 the sun.

園.name: Park
園.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical>, a <radical>mouth</radical> and <radical>clothes</radical> in an <radical>enclosure</radical>. People picnic in fancy clothes inside the fenced <kanji>park</kanji>.
園.reading: Entry costs a yen, えん. 公園 is a park; 動物園 a zoo.

馬.name: Horse
馬.meaning: The <radical>horse</radical> radical: <kanji>horse</kanji>. The mane flies off the top and four legs run underneath.
馬.reading: The horse is having a bath, ば. On its own a horse is うま.

顔.name: Face
顔.meaning: <radical>Stand</radical> under a <radical>cliff</radical> with your <radical>hair</radical> blowing next to your <radical>head</radical>. The wind blasts your <kanji>face</kanji>.
顔.reading: かお: the wind makes you go "kah-oh!" 顔 is the face. In compounds it's がん: 洗顔, face wash.

船.name: Ship
船.meaning: A <radical>boat</radical> with <radical>eight</radical> <radical>mouth</radical>s on board. A boat carrying eight people is a proper <kanji>ship</kanji>.
船.reading: The ticket costs one cent, せん. On its own a ship is ふね.

遠.name: Far
遠.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical>, a <radical>mouth</radical> and <radical>clothes</radical> all riding a <radical>scooter</radical>. Pack your clothes and snacks: it's <kanji>far</kanji>.
遠.reading: The fare is one yen, えん, per kilometre. 遠い is far; 遠慮 reserve.

絵.name: Picture
絵.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical>s that <radical>meet</radical>. Weave them together and you get a <kanji>picture</kanji>.
絵.reading: "え?" you say, a startled "eh?" when you see it. 絵 on its own is a picture.

晴.name: Clear Up
晴.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> in a <radical>blue</radical> sky. The weather has <kanji>clear</kanji>ed <kanji>up</kanji>.
晴.reading: はれ: you shout "hurray!" 晴れ is sunny. In compounds it's せい: 快晴. Notice 青 inside, a sound hint for せい.

雪.name: Snow
雪.meaning: <radical>Rain</radical> over a <radical>broom</radical>. Rain you have to sweep up is <kanji>snow</kanji>.
雪.reading: It buries a whole set of dishes, せつ. On its own snow is ゆき.

鳴.name: Chirp
鳴.reading: なく: the bird chirps "knock knock" on your window. 鳴く is to chirp; 鳴る to ring. In compounds it's めい.

才.name: Talent
才.meaning: A hand grabbing a stick in one smooth movement. That takes <kanji>talent</kanji>. It also counts years of age: <ja>二十才</ja>.
才.reading: Wield a scythe, さい, with talent. 天才 is a genius.

対.name: Opposite
対.meaning: <radical>Writing</radical> <radical>glue</radical>d to a board. Each page is glued to the <kanji>opposite</kanji> one.
対.reading: They're tied with a tie, たい. 反対 is opposition; 対 is versus.

部.name: Part
部.meaning: <radical>Stand</radical> and <radical>mouth</radical> in a <radical>town</radical>. Each speaker represents one <kanji>part</kanji> of town.
部.reading: They all wear boots, ぶ. 部屋 is a room (へ); 全部 all; 部長 department head.

相.name: Mutual
相.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> and an <radical>eye</radical>. You stare at the tree and it stares back. It's <kanji>mutual</kanji>.
相.reading: Throw a soda can, そう, and it throws one back. 相談 is a consultation; 相手 partner (あい).

定.name: Decide
定.meaning: A <radical>coat rack</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical>. Once you've hung your coat, you've <kanji>decide</kanji>d to stay.
定.reading: Put your hat on the table, てい. 予定 is a plan; 決定 a decision.

実.name: Truth
実.meaning: <radical>Three</radical> <radical>person</radical>s under a <radical>roof</radical> eating fruit. They all tell the same story, so it must be the <kanji>truth</kanji>.
実.reading: They arrived by jet, じつ. 実は is actually; 事実 a fact.

決.name: Decide
決.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> next to something <radical>big</radical>. Stand at the edge of a big waterfall and <kanji>decide</kanji>: jump or not?
決.reading: You jump into a kettle, けつ. 決める is to decide.

全.name: All
全.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> with a roof over the <radical>king</radical>. The king protects <kanji>all</kanji> his people.
全.reading: He's a zen monk king, ぜん. 全部 is all; 安全 safety.

表.name: Surface
表.meaning: <radical>Two</radical> lines and a <radical>stick</radical> sewn onto <radical>clothes</radical>. The pattern on the <kanji>surface</kanji> shows what you want to express.
表.reading: A hyena, ひょう, is printed on the front. 表 is a table or chart; 発表 an announcement.

調.name: Investigate
調.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> something on each <radical>lap</radical> around the room. You're <kanji>investigate</kanji>ing, asking everyone.
調.reading: Your bribe is chocolate, ちょう. 調べる is to investigate; 調子 condition.

化.name: Change
化.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> next to a <radical>spoon</radical>. One spoonful of potion and the person <kanji>change</kanji>s.
化.reading: They turn into a car, か. 文化 is culture; 化学 chemistry; お化け a ghost (ば).

期.name: Period
期.meaning: Something <radical>sweet</radical> and <radical>eight</radical> <radical>moon</radical>s. You're allowed one sweet every eight months. That's a long <kanji>period</kanji>.
期.reading: Lock the sweets up with a key, き. 期間 is a period; 期待 expectation.

取.name: Take
取.meaning: An <radical>ear</radical> and a <radical>stool</radical>. Stand on a stool to reach up and <kanji>take</kanji> someone by the ear.
取.reading: You take their shoe, しゅ, too. 取る is to take.

都.name: Capital
都.meaning: <radical>Someone</radical> from every <radical>town</radical> ends up in the <kanji>capital</kanji>.
都.reading: They all arrive by toe, と, walking. 東京都 is Tokyo Metropolis; 都合 convenience (つ).

和.name: Peace
和.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> and a <radical>mouth</radical>. Everyone has enough to eat, so there's <kanji>peace</kanji>. It's also the old name for Japan.
和.reading: Wave a wand, わ, and there's peace. 平和 is peace; 和食 Japanese food.

平.name: Flat
平.meaning: Two sides balanced on a pole: it's perfectly <kanji>flat</kanji> and even.
平.reading: Stack hay bales on it, へい. 平和 is peace; 平気 calm.

受.name: Receive
受.meaning: A <radical>claw</radical> reaching down to a <radical>lid</radical>, and a <radical>stool</radical> underneath. You stand on the stool to <kanji>receive</kanji> the gift being passed down.
受.reading: It's a juice box, じゅ. 受ける is to receive; 受付 reception.

進.name: Advance
進.meaning: A <radical>turkey</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. It <kanji>advance</kanji>s on the enemy.
進.reading: It kicks you in the shin, しん. 進む is to advance.

指.name: Finger
指.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> next to something <radical>delicious</radical>. Lick your <kanji>finger</kanji> and point at what you want.
指.reading: You're pointing at a sheep, し. 指 on its own is ゆび; 指す is to point.

予.name: In Advance
予.meaning: <radical>Mama</radical> says "<radical>finish</radical> it first." You do things <kanji>in advance</kanji> in her house.
予.reading: You practise your yo-yo, よ, in advance. 予定 is a plan; 予約 a reservation.

向.name: Facing
向.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> inside a <radical>helmet</radical> with a feather <radical>slide</radical>ing off the top. The knight is <kanji>facing</kanji> you.
向.reading: It's a koala knight, こう. 向こう is over there; 方向 direction.

勝.name: Win
勝.meaning: The <radical>moon</radical>, <radical>two</radical> <radical>person</radical>s and <radical>power</radical>. Two people fight under the moon until one of them <kanji>win</kanji>s.
勝.reading: It's a show, しょう, and the crowd loves it. 勝つ is to win.

面.name: Face
面.meaning: The <radical>face</radical> radical: <kanji>face</kanji>. Also a mask, or one side of something.
面.reading: You get a bowl of ramen, めん, in the face. 面白い is interesting; 画面 a screen.

反.name: Against
反.meaning: A <radical>stool</radical> under a <radical>cliff</radical>. You shove the stool <kanji>against</kanji> the rock face.
反.reading: You push with your hand, はん. 反対 is opposition.

所.name: Place
所.meaning: A <radical>door</radical> and an <radical>axe</radical>. Chop a door into a wall and you've made a <kanji>place</kanji> to live.
所.reading: Dig the foundation with a shovel, しょ. 場所 is place; ところ on its own; 台所 kitchen (どころ).

欠.name: Lack
欠.meaning: The <radical>yawn</radical> radical. You yawn because you <kanji>lack</kanji> sleep.
欠.reading: Boil a kettle, けつ, for coffee. 欠点 is a flaw; 欠ける to be missing.

次.name: Next
次.meaning: <radical>Ice</radical> and a <radical>yawn</radical>. You yawn waiting for the ice cream line to move. You're <kanji>next</kanji>!
次.reading: A jeep, じ, is next in line behind you. 次 on its own is つぎ.

係.name: Connection
係.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> holding a <radical>lineage</radical> chart. They're in charge of every family <kanji>connection</kanji>.
係.reading: They record it all on a cake, けい. 関係 is a relationship; 係 the person in charge (かかり).

感.name: Feeling
感.meaning: A <radical>halberd</radical>, a <radical>mouth</radical> under a <radical>cliff</radical>, and a <radical>heart</radical> underneath. A blade stabs through all of it. You have a <kanji>feeling</kanji> about this.
感.reading: A kangaroo, かん, has the same feeling. 感じる is to feel; 感謝 gratitude.

投.name: Throw
投.reading: You hit a toad, とう. 投げる is to throw.

打.name: Hit
打.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> on the <radical>street</radical>. You make a fist and <kanji>hit</kanji> the pavement.
打.reading: You throw a dart instead, だ. 打つ is to hit.

両.name: Both
両.meaning: A <radical>mountain</radical> inside a <radical>helmet</radical> under the <radical>ground</radical> line: it's split down the middle, one peak on each side. <kanji>Both</kanji>.
両.reading: Both halves go to the rodeo, りょう. 両親 is parents; 両方 both.

式.name: Ceremony
式.meaning: A <radical>ceremony</radical> stake next to <radical>craft</radical>. A crafted stage for the <kanji>ceremony</kanji>.
式.reading: A sheik, しき, is the guest of honour. 結婚式 is a wedding; 正式 formal.

談.name: Discuss
談.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> things around a <radical>flame</radical>. Sit round the campfire and <kanji>discuss</kanji>.
談.reading: A dancer, だん, joins in. 相談 is a consultation; 冗談 a joke.

流.name: Flow
流.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, a <radical>top hat</radical>, something <radical>private</radical> and a <radical>river</radical>. Your hat and your secret float off with the <kanji>flow</kanji>.
流.reading: A dragon, りゅう, rides the current. 流れる is to flow.

局.name: Bureau
局.meaning: A <radical>flag</radical> over a <radical>phrase</radical>. The government <kanji>bureau</kanji> hangs its slogan out front.
局.reading: It's a Kyoto office, きょく. 郵便局 is a post office; 結局 in the end.

放.name: Release
放.meaning: A <radical>direction</radical> and a <radical>whip</radical>. Crack the whip and point the direction: <kanji>release</kanji> the horses!
放.reading: Spray them with a hose, ほう. 放送 is a broadcast; 放す to release.

求.name: Request
求.meaning: A <radical>splash</radical> with an extra <radical>drop</radical>. You're in the desert and you <kanji>request</kanji> one more drop.
求.reading: You bang on the bar with a cue stick, きゅう. 求める is to seek; 要求 a demand.

球.name: Ball
球.meaning: The <radical>king</radical> makes a <radical>request</radical>: bring me a <kanji>ball</kanji>.
球.reading: He hits it with a cue stick, きゅう. 野球 is baseball; 地球 the Earth.

役.name: Role
役.meaning: <radical>Going</radical> out with a <radical>weapon</radical>. That's your <kanji>role</kanji>: guard duty.
役.reading: You ride a yak, やく, on patrol. 役に立つ is to be useful; 役所 a government office.

由.name: Reason
由.meaning: A <radical>stick</radical> poking up through the <radical>sun</radical>. There must be a <kanji>reason</kanji> for that.
由.reading: The reason is a unicorn, ゆ. 理由 is a reason; 自由 freedom (ゆう).

消.name: Erase
消.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> on something with a <radical>resemblance</radical> to fire. Pour on water to <kanji>erase</kanji> it.
消.reading: It ends the show, しょう. 消す is to turn off; 消しゴム an eraser.

申.name: Say
申.meaning: A <radical>stick</radical> straight through the <radical>sun</radical>. It's lightning striking, and the gods have something to <kanji>say</kanji>. Used for saying things humbly: <ja>申す</ja>.
申.reading: It hits your shin, しん. 申し込む is to apply.

神.name: God
神.meaning: An <radical>altar</radical> for the one who <radical>say</radical>s things with lightning. A <kanji>god</kanji>.
神.reading: He strikes your shin, しん. 神社 is a Shinto shrine; かみ on its own is a god.

配.name: Distribute
配.meaning: <radical>Sake</radical> for <radical>oneself</radical>? No, you have to <kanji>distribute</kanji> it to everyone.
配.reading: Everyone gets a high five, はい, too. 心配 is worry; 配る to distribute.

育.name: Raise
育.meaning: A <radical>top hat</radical> over something <radical>private</radical> and a <radical>moon</radical>. It takes many moons to <kanji>raise</kanji> a child right.
育.reading: You feed it from an ink bottle, いく. 教育 is education; 育てる to raise.

乗.name: Ride
乗.meaning: A <radical>thousand</radical> people up in a <radical>tree</radical>. They're all trying to <kanji>ride</kanji> it.
乗.reading: A joker, じょう, sells tickets. 乗る is to ride; 乗車 boarding.

想.name: Idea
想.meaning: <radical>Mutual</radical> over your <radical>heart</radical>. Two hearts share one <kanji>idea</kanji>.
想.reading: Write it on a soda can, そう. 予想 is a forecast; 想像 imagination.

助.name: Help
助.meaning: <radical>Moreover</radical>, <radical>power</radical>. You need more power: call for <kanji>help</kanji>!
助.reading: Cousin Joe, じょ, comes to help. 助ける is to help.

追.name: Chase
追.meaning: Something <radical>slide</radical>s off a <radical>scooter</radical> and you <kanji>chase</kanji> after it.
追.reading: You tweet, つい, about it while running. 追う is to chase; 追加 addition.

商.name: Trade
商.meaning: <radical>Stand</radical> under a <radical>helmet</radical> on <radical>legs</radical>, opening your <radical>mouth</radical> to shout prices. You're in <kanji>trade</kanji>.
商.reading: It's quite a show, しょう. 商品 is goods; 商店 a shop.

葉.name: Leaf
葉.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical> above the <radical>world</radical> above a <radical>tree</radical>. The top of the tree is covered in <kanji>leaf</kanji>.
葉.reading: Leaves fall on your yo-yo, よう. On its own a leaf is は; 言葉 (word) uses ば.

落.name: Fall
落.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical>, <radical>water</radical>, and <radical>each</radical>. Each leaf and each raindrop will <kanji>fall</kanji>.
落.reading: They fall onto a rack of lamb, らく. 落ちる is to fall.

負.name: Lose
負.meaning: A <radical>hook</radical> over a <radical>shell</radical>. Someone hooked your money: you <kanji>lose</kanji>.
負.reading: まける: you make excuses when you lose. 負ける is to lose. In compounds it's ふ: 勝負, a match.

守.name: Protect
守.meaning: <radical>Glue</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical>. You glue the house shut to <kanji>protect</kanji> it.
守.reading: You guard it with a shoe, しゅ. 守る is to protect; 留守 away from home (す).

美.name: Beauty
美.meaning: A <radical>sheep</radical> that is <radical>big</radical>. In the old days a big fat sheep was the height of <kanji>beauty</kanji>.
美.reading: A bee, び, lands on it and agrees. 美しい is beautiful; 美術館 an art museum.
